definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of {安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう} (anzen hoshou, security). Most commonly refers to the US-Japan Security Treaty ({日米|にちべい}{安保|あんぽ}{条約|じょうやく}) or national security policy in general. Frequently appears in news and political discussion.

examples.japanese: {安保|あんぽ}⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{改定|かいてい}→改定：13036_kaitei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{安保|あんぽ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧になっている。
examples.english: Debate about security has been intensifying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日米|にちべい}→日米：13092_nichibei⟧{安保|あんぽ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The US-Japan security alliance has been the foundation of postwar Japanese diplomacy.

notes:
USAGE:
Abbreviation of ⟦{安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう}→安全保障：05788_anzenhoshou⟧. In Japanese political discourse, {安保|あんぽ} most often refers to the US-Japan Security Treaty ({日米|にちべい}{安保|あんぽ}{条約|じょうやく}). The {安保|あんぽ}⟦{闘争|とうそう}→闘争：14574_tousou⟧ (Anpo protests) of 1960 were massive demonstrations against the treaty's renewal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日米|にちべい}→日米：13092_nichibei⟧{安保|あんぽ}: US-Japan security alliance
- {安保|あんぽ}⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧: security treaty
- {安保|あんぽ}⟦{理事会|りじかい}→理事会：18635_rijikai⟧: Security Council (of the UN)
- {安保|あんぽ}{法制|ほうせい}: security legislation
